data.revised_prompt: Create a high-quality 3D chibi educational-app style square avatar icon for a school teacher/admin student profile library. Single fictional Chinese girl only, age 8–14, clearly a student. Composition: centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail but refined, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Head-and-face focused, front view or very slight three-quarter view. Face and hair should occupy 75%–85% of the frame; only a tiny amount of shoulders/neck visible at the bottom, not a half-body portrait. Full hair outline visible inside the frame, no crop on top or chin. Hairstyle: two neat low braids on left and right, tidy airy bangs, small green hair ties at the ends of the braids, clearly distinguishable at 48px. Expression: serious/concentrated but friendly. Eyes: bright warm brown, soft studio lighting, gentle glossy 3D modeling, smooth materials, subtle educational-app mascot quality; explicitly a student, not an adult, not a teacher. Clothing: only a small sliver of white school collar visible at the bottom, no insignia, no text. Background: fully filled edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner with a low-saturation lavender purple, no borders, no transparency, no circular frame, no halo, no scene elements. Overall style: premium 3D Q-version education app avatar, clean silhouette, soft studio light, clearly distinct facial features and accessories, centered, polished, child-appropriate. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, props, teacher, adult, headset, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top crop, hair crop, chin crop, face too small, off-center person, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circle background, avatar frame, ring, halo, scene, text, letters, numbers, school badge, logo, watermark, multiple characters, realistic photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low resolution, distorted facial features.
